children: Glacier Bancorp appointed Byron Pollan as Senior Vice President and Deputy Chief Financial Officer, to become CFO upon the current CFO's mid-2027 retirement.
Board named Byron Pollan Deputy Chief Financial Officer effective Sept 1, 2026, in a newly created role.
Pollan will succeed Ron Copher as Executive VP and Chief Financial Officer upon Copher’s retirement planned for mid-2027.
Copher will remain with the company in an advisory role to support a smooth transition.
Pollan brings 27 years of banking experience; has been Senior VP and Treasurer of Glacier Bancorp since Jan 2017 and is a CFA charterholder.
